name: Secure the Mountain
label: Quest
description: Secure the Mountain: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Spelunking dark caves is adventurer business. My job's just to make reports and send them over to Ironforge.
Trouble is, one of my reports hasn't... Well, reported back. I asked a few mountaineers to learn more about the wendigo problem we have out here, but I haven't heard from them.
If you're already going to be out and about, what say you don't check in with Mountaineer Gretchen just west of town. I'm late enough as it is!

clips.title: Completion
paras: I got his report, alright. This whole situation's a mess!

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
